tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search Albert Tan Sin Hon's public scholarship, manuscripts, software and other profile-listed outputs, plus IBOL teaching guides. Returns source links, contributor credit, recorded status and rights. Deterministic word matching over a dated snapshot; the writings' full text is not searched.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Retrieve one catalogue record or IBOL lesson summary by its exact ID from search_resources. Preserves source links, recorded citation details, contributor credit, limitations and licences. For the full companion lesson guide use get_ibol_lesson. This tool does not retrieve publications' full text.

tools.name: get_ibol_lesson
tools.description: Retrieve the full companion teaching guide for one of eight IBOL lessons on financial law, insurance and trust governance, including its seminar plan, exercise, source locators, legal cut-off and separate teaching/book rights.
